Definition: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
BiblicalUsage: 1) midst, middle; 1a) midst, middle; 1b) into, through (after verbs of motion); 1c) among (of a number of persons); 1d) between (of things arranged by twos); 1e) from among (as to take or separate etc)
